The play pattern is about threading through successive hazard lanes or bands in a forward-scrolling environment, even though movement is vertical rather than lane-switch based.
The presentation strongly emphasizes neon sci-fi runner aesthetics with glowing cyan highlights, grid backgrounds, and arcade HUD styling.
Gravity is the dominant movement constraint and the player repeatedly counters it with thrust-like taps, making gravity management central to survival.
The game is obstacle-focused and precision-based, but it lacks discrete platforming sections or traversal checkpoints typical of stronger obby interpretations.
